name: Lilith
source:
Hometown: Dodona
Occupation: Apprentice Priest
Weapon: i-Scepter (Staff)

She is ignorant of the ways of the world, but she has a kind and straightforward heart.
Even though she may be ignorant, because of that she has the potential to feel pure love.
